label: 仰卧屈腿抬膝
pose_lead: Grounded pose, supine with the knees lifted off the ground:
lower_limbs: Both legs leave the ground, the hips and knees deeply bent, the shins folding back and upward, the feet drawn close.
upper_limbs: One arm extends along the ground to one side, the other bends close to the head, shoulder or upper body.
torso_head: The upper body turns slightly sideways, the head and shoulders just off the ground or tilted to one side.
weight_silhouette: The lifted legs become the main visual focus; upper and lower body point different ways with a light twist.
